summary.headline: Sirius Rising and Lunar Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the rising of Sirius when the Moon is in Capricorn, Aquarius, or Pisces, forecasting crop conditions, disease, deaths, storms, earthquakes, wars, rebellions, political troubles, and disasters in Egypt, Alexandria, the Nile, and surrounding regions.
